cohort: 48 pregnant women with nuchal cord and 48 healthy pregnant women during labor
finding: Fetal umbilical cord serum thiol/disulphide homeostasis is impaired in labor with the presence of a nuchal cord, but vaginal delivery can be safely and successfully performed in these pregnancies.
mod_finding: The group of patients with nuchal cord had higher emergency C-section numbers indicated for fetal distress.
